case.summary: Customer C07297 reported a fraudulent online purchase of $482.12 on card C07297-K1, which was part of a burst of four online transactions within an hour ranging from $456.96 to $488.04. The cardholder denied making the transaction, and the exposure totals $1,906.07 across the four unauthorized items. The activity matches an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern identified across multiple other cards.

sar.narrative: On November 21, 2016, customer C07297 contacted the bank to dispute a $482.12 online purchase on card C07297-K1, stating they never made the transaction. Investigation revealed a burst of four online purchases within an hour, each priced just under the $500 authorization threshold. This coordinated activity forms part of an undocumented pattern seen across 13 other cards, totaling 51 transactions and $24,262.56 in exposure. The device profile used in the attack was shared across multiple cards with historical fraud cases. The transactions are highly suspicious because the amounts significantly exceed the cardholder baseline average and occurred in rapid succession. Consequently, the card requires blocking and a suspicious activity report must be filed.

stop_reason: The cardholder's denial settles the verdict under R2 and the graph evidence has been collected; further steps would not change the actions.
